description: This file defines application routing for a Flutter app, including route names, a list of all routes, and a function to build the route table mapping route names to widget builders with specified screens.

classes.name: AppRoutes
classes.description: Contains static constants for route names and a list of all routes.

methods.name: buildAppRoutes
methods.description: Creates and returns a map of route names to widget builder functions, registering key routes with corresponding screens.
